title: Typed put and get round-trip a value through the KV driver realising the Workers KV binding shape
asA: developer using the facade behind an app request handler
iWant: facade.put(key, value) then facade.get(key) to return the same bytes, with paired kvWrite and kvHit events
soThat: a request handler can persist and read state deterministically through one seam

acceptanceCriteria.description: facade.put(key, value) writes a value; facade.get(key) returns the same bytes; both operations emit their paired lifecycle events (kvWrite on put, kvHit on get). The round-trip works against the in-memory KV driver in the cf-platform fixture (src/kv-driver.mjs) whose binding shape matches the real Workers KV binding contract per https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/api/.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the facade wired to the in-memory KV driver in the cf-platform fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: the facade-round-trip probe puts a fixture key/value and reads it back
acceptanceCriteria.then: the read returns the same bytes; the event sink records one kvWrite and one kvHit; the probe report aggregates to pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: facade.delete(key) removes a value; a subsequent facade.get(key) returns null and emits kvMiss.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a key previously put via the facade
acceptanceCriteria.then: the delete emits kvWrite; the get returns null and emits kvMiss

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-5 getWithMetadata verb: facade.getWithMetadata(key) returns {value, metadata} on a key put with metadata; the value equals the put value and metadata equals the {v:<number>} shape per the kv-metadata-field-pattern elicit. A miss returns {value:null, metadata:null} and emits a kvMiss record on the sink.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired to the in-memory driver with a key put via facade.put(k, v, {metadata:{v:1}})
acceptanceCriteria.then: the hit returns {value, metadata:{v:1}} and emits kvHit; the miss returns {value:null, metadata:null} and emits kvMiss

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-5 per-call TTL propagation: facade.put(k, v, {expirationTtl:5}) writes with the per-call TTL. A fake-clock advance past 5000ms and a subsequent facade.get(k) returns null and emits kvMiss (the TTL has expired from the driver's perspective). The kvWrite record on the initial put carries ttl:5.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade with a fake-clock driver
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.put(k, v, {expirationTtl:5}) then clock advances 5001ms and facade.get(k) runs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the kvWrite record carries ttl:5; the subsequent facade.get returns null and emits kvMiss

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-7 write failure boundary: facade.put(k, v) whose underlying driver put throws (simulated by a stubbed driver that rejects on put) surfaces the error unwrapped with a stable error kind KV_WRITE_FAILED naming the key k in the wrapped message. No kvWrite record emits on the sink for the failed put.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired to a driver whose put rejects synthetically
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call rejects with KV_WRITE_FAILED naming the key; the sink records zero kvWrite for this call

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-7 read failure boundary: facade.get(k) whose underlying driver get throws (simulated by a stubbed driver that rejects on get) surfaces the error unwrapped with a stable error kind KV_READ_FAILED naming the key. No kvHit or kvMiss record emits on the sink for the failed get.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired to a driver whose get rejects synthetically
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call rejects with KV_READ_FAILED naming the key; the sink records zero kvHit and zero kvMiss for this call
